title: Software development with AI coding assistants
about: Extension case: written to show how the lexicon carries to a second setting. Synthetic; not yet tested on fieldwork.

T.title: Tracker
T.definition: Ticket tracker and notifications: where work arrives and is prioritised.

E.title: Editor
E.definition: Code editor, including inline AI completions.

S.title: Side panel
S.definition: AI chat panel, documentation and web search beside the editor.

X.title: Terminal
X.definition: Terminal: running code, tests and reading logs.

P.title: Pull request
P.definition: Version control and code review: commits, pull requests, review comments, merge.

Issue tracker.definition: Ticket or issue tracker (e.g. Jira, Linear).

Code assistant.definition: Inline AI completion in the editor.

AI chat.definition: AI chat assistant in a side panel or browser.

AI review bot.definition: AI that comments on pull requests.

Terminal.definition: Shell, local run, test runner, logs.

Git host.definition: Version control host: branches, pull requests, review, merge.

CI.definition: Continuous integration: automated builds and tests on each push.

Pick up ticket.definition: Choose the next ticket and read what is asked.

Read code.definition: Read the existing code around the change.

Write code.definition: The developer's own writing or editing of code.

Accept inline suggestion.definition: Accept an AI completion offered in the editor.

Ask AI assistant.definition: Put a question or error to an AI chat assistant and read its answer.

Paste AI answer.definition: Copy code or text from the AI answer into the work.

Read documentation.definition: Look up documentation, examples or forum answers.

Run code.definition: Run the program locally and look at what happens.

Run tests.definition: Run the test suite or specific tests.

Read error output.definition: Read an error message, stack trace or log.

Ask colleague.definition: Ask or answer a colleague in chat or in person.

Open pull request.definition: Commit, push and open a pull request for review.

AI review comment.definition: An AI reviewer comments on the pull request.

Human review.definition: A colleague reviews the pull request and comments.

CI result.definition: Automated build and tests report pass or fail.

Merge.definition: Merge the change. The point where a claim reaches closure.

ai_models.inline_completion: Completion that appears as ghost text in the editor.
ai_models.chat_assistant: Conversational assistant answering questions or proposing code.
ai_models.ai_review: Automated reviewer commenting on pull requests.
ai_models.other: Any other model; name it in detail.

independent_checks: Running the code, running tests, CI results, documentation, a colleague's review. Re-reading the AI answer is not a check.
